name: David McMillan
bio:
David McMillan's journey into motorsport finance was somewhat unconventional, beginning with a successful career in corporate accounting before a chance encounter with a V8 Supercars team owner at a charity golf event. Intrigued by the fast-paced, high-stakes environment, David transitioned his skills to motorsport, quickly proving his value in managing the complex finances of a racing team. He joined V8 Masters Racing after several years at a smaller team.

David is known for his meticulous approach to budgeting and cost control, ensuring every dollar is strategically allocated to optimize performance on and off the track. His experience in corporate environments has given him a unique perspective, allowing him to identify inefficiencies and implement innovative financial strategies. While not involved in the technical aspects of the cars, David deeply appreciates the engineering and dedication that goes into each race.

What sets David apart is his relentless pursuit of financial efficiency and his ability to translate complex financial data into actionable insights for the team. He is a strong advocate for data-driven decision-making, ensuring that every financial choice is aligned with the team's overall strategic objectives. He also has a knack for spotting hidden opportunities and manages the team's investments.

physical.description: A man of medium build, David always looks impeccably dressed.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down financial insights.
Insists on using a specific brand of calculator, claiming it's the only one that gets the numbers right.
Has a framed picture of Alan Jones on his desk.
